session_history.summary: Analyzed X_AI.md and venice/api.py - Found that the xAI implementation has naming confusion. The function get_zai_api_key() claims to be for "Z.ai (xAI)" but these are two different companies. The models configured (zai-org-glm-5, zai-org/GLM-5) are Zhipu AI models, not xAI Grok models. The environment variable XAI_API_KEY is correct per xAI docs, but the actual models and provider configuration are for Zhipu AI, not xAI. To properly support xAI, the app would need Grok model names (grok-4, grok-4.20-reasoning, etc.) and the correct API endpoint (https://api.x.ai/v1).
